plan.archetype: Flexible multi-hit damage, dexterity defense, and poison scaling
plan.bossPrep: Use multiple hits to strip nine Slippery stacks. Prepare efficient damage, upgraded defense, and Weak or temporary Strength reduction for the 30-damage attack.
plan.summary: Add efficient attacks first, then dexterity and mitigation. Build poison scaling when supported. Remove Strikes after replacing their damage; take elites only with sufficient health and combat strength.
